StepDescription: Launch Lorenzo Application
Login with valid credentials
Wait for home page to load after login
-- NAVIGATE TO MY WORK IP WARD --
Click My Work application tab on home page
Wait for My Work context pane to load
Click IP Ward link from My Work context pane
Wait for Inpatient ward selection list to load
-- SELECT WARD A FROM AVAILABLE WARDS --
Select Ward A checkbox from ward list
Click OK to confirm ward selection
Wait for ward pegboard grid to load
Verify IP ward pegboard grid is displayed
-- INITIATE ADMISSION FROM EMPTY SLOT --
Click empty bed slot on ward pegboard to initiate admission
Click Admit from context sub-task pane
Wait for patient search/registration page to load
-- REGISTER NEW PATIENT WITH REFERRAL DETAILS --
Generate random surname for new patient
Enter patient forename on admit search page
Enter random surname on admit search page
Enter date of birth
Select patient gender
Click Find to search for patient
Wait for search results
Click Registration link to register new patient (no match found)
Wait for patient registration form to load
Enter patient Forename on registration form
Enter Postal Code for address lookup
Click Find to resolve address from postal code
Wait for address lookup results
Select address row from lookup results
Select Country
Click Finish Now to complete patient registration
Wait for registration confirmation popup
Capture NHS Number from registration confirmation
Click OK to dismiss registration confirmation popup
Wait for admission roadmap to load
Select Admission Source
Select Admission Type
Select Intended Management
Click Create Referral link to add referral details during admission
Wait for Create Referral form to load
Select Referral Service Type
Select Referral Source
Select Referral Priority
Select Referral Type
Click Finish Now to submit referral
Wait for admission roadmap to reload after referral creation
Select Ward Name for admission bed allocation
Click Next to proceed to admission confirmation
Wait for admission confirmation page to load
Click Finish to complete patient admission
Wait for ward pegboard to reload after admission
-- VERIFY PATIENT ADMISSION STATUS: ADMITTED --
Verify patient row is visible on ward pegboard confirming Admitted status
Verify IP Ward History link is accessible confirming admission completed
-- NAVIGATE TO MY WORK THEATRE TAB --
Click My Work application tab to access context pane
Wait for My Work context pane to load
Click Theatre link from My Work context pane
Wait for Theatre session search page to load
-- SELECT ACTIVE THEATRE SUITE SESSION --
Select Theatre Suite from the list
Select Active session status filter
Click Find to search for active theatre sessions
Wait for theatre session search results
-- CREATE THEATRE BOOKING --
Click Book link to initiate theatre booking for the selected session
Wait for Theatre Booking form to load
Enter patient NHS number or identifier to find patient
Click Find to search for the admitted patient
Wait for patient search results in booking form
Click OK to add the selected patient to the theatre booking
-- CONFIGURE BOOKING: OPERATION PROFILE --
Click Operation Profile search icon to select operation profile
Wait for Operation Profile search form to load
Enter operation profile name to search
Click Find to search for operation profile
Wait for operation profile search results
Select first matching operation profile from results
Click OK to confirm operation profile selection
Wait for booking form to reload with operation profile
Click Next to proceed to booking date and time configuration
Wait for booking date and time configuration page
Select booking priority
Click Finish to finalize the theatre booking
Wait for theatre booking to complete and session grid to reload
-- VERIFY THEATRE BOOKING STATUS: BOOKED --
Click Booking details tab to view booking status
Wait for booking details to load
Verify Booking details tab is visible confirming Booked status
Verify Modify booking link is available confirming patient is Booked
-- MODIFY THEATRE BOOKING --
Click Modify booking link to update operation profile
Wait for Modify Booking form to load
Click Yes on consent popup if displayed for modify booking
Click Operation Profile search icon to change operation profile
Wait for Operation Profile search form
Enter new operation profile name
Click Find to search for new operation profile
Wait for operation profile search results
Select first row from new operation profile search results
Click OK to confirm new operation profile selection
Select reason for modification
Click Finish to save modified booking
Wait for booking modification to complete
-- VERIFY MODIFIED BOOKING DETAILS --
Click Booking details tab to verify updated booking
Wait for booking details to load
Verify Booking details tab shows updated booking information
-- IN-THEATRE WORKFLOW: NAVIGATE TO IN-THEATRE TAB --
Click In-Theatre tab on home page
Wait for In-Theatre management page to load
-- SELECT ACTIVE THEATRE SUITE SESSION IN IN-THEATRE TAB --
Select Active session status in In-Theatre management
Click OK to confirm session status selection
Select Theatre Suite for in-theatre session
Click Find to search for active in-theatre sessions
Wait for in-theatre session grid to load
-- ACCESS HUB AND VERIFY DATE TIME PASID --
Click Hub icon for the booked patient session
Wait for Hub patient detail page to load
Verify Hub page loaded with stage groups visible
Verify Hub menu icon is visible confirming Hub access
-- RECORD STAGES: CHECK-IN --
Click Check-in stage tab
Wait for Check-in stage to load
Click NOW to record Check-in time
Wait for Check-in time to be recorded
-- RECORD STAGES: ANAESTHESIA --
Click Anaesthesia stage tab
Wait for Anaesthesia stage to load
Click NOW to record Anaesthesia start time
Wait for Anaesthesia time to be recorded
-- RECORD STAGES: OPERATION --
Click Operation stage tab
Wait for Operation stage to load
Click NOW to record Operation started time
Wait for operation started time to be recorded
Click NOW to record Operation end time
Wait for operation end time to be recorded
-- RECORD STAGES: RECOVERY --
Click Recovery stage tab
Wait for Recovery stage to load
Click NOW to record Recovery time
Wait for Recovery time to be recorded
-- RECORD STAGES: DEPARTURE --
Click Departure stage tab
Wait for Departure stage to load
Click NOW to record Departure time
Wait for Departure time to be recorded
Close stage Hub after completing all mandatory stage groups
Wait for in-theatre session grid to reload after stages recorded
-- ADD PROCEDURES VIA MANAGE OPERATION --
Click Hub menu icon to access manage operation options
Wait for Hub menu to expand
Click Manage operation link from Hub menu
Wait for Manage operation page to load
Click Add procedure to add a new procedure
Wait for procedure search form to load
Enter procedure name to search
Click Search to find the procedure
Wait for procedure search results
Select the procedure from search results
Click OK to confirm procedure selection
Wait for procedure to be added
Click OK to save Manage operation details
Wait for manage operation to save
-- FINAL VALIDATION: THEATRE EVENT OVERVIEW --
Click expand icon to access Theatre event overview option
Wait for expand panel to appear
Click Theatre event overview link
Wait for Theatre event overview to load
Click Operation tab in Theatre event overview
Wait for Operation tab to load in overview
Verify procedure is listed in Theatre event overview Operation tab
Verify Theatre event overview Operation tab is accessible
Close Theatre event overview
Wait for in-theatre session grid after closing overview
Click Theatre logout icon to log out of in-theatre application
Click Log out from logout menu to confirm logout
Click Yes to confirm exit from Lorenzo application
Wait for logout to complete
